pageCache.text:
A school where all can learn and grow in mind, body and spirit
St Mary's Church of England Primary School
Tucked away in the heart of Horsham town centre, St Mary's is a forward-thinking Church of England primary school where we aim to make everyone feel valued, learning and growing together.
"Let your light shine!" - Matthew 5:16
We are blessed to have a diverse and active community who work together in all sorts of ways to achieve our shared vision: A school where all can learn and grow in mind, body and spirit. Work and play are given equal importance here. Children get once precious chance at childhood, and we aim to make the most of it!
Apply Now!

pageCache.text:
Art Knowledge Organisers
Our knowledge organisers detail new knowledge, key skills and vocabulary introduced with each unit, including the key artists and example of the artworks studied.
They also show which media the children will be using and new techniques they will develop.
Y1 Nature Installations Clay Relief Wildlife
Y1 Seascapes Mixed Printing
Y1 Self-portraits and castle collages
Y2 Farm Landscapes Jaipur Textiles
Y2 Landscapes Cut Paper Sculptures
Y2 Townscapes 3D paper sculptures
Y3 Light and Dark
Y3 Mosaics and Frescoes
Y4 Impressionist Waterscapes Edo Movement
Y4 Messages in Art
Y4 Sculpture

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's CE Primary School - Church Partnership
pageCache.text:
Church Partnership
Throughout their time at St Mary's, children have many and varied opportunities to visit St Mary's Church and other local churches, both for worship and as part of our curriculum learning in Religious Education.
You can find an overview of our main visits here, though we often pop over for other things too!
Calendar of Church Experiences
St Mary's CE Church, Horsham
St Mary's Church supports the school with services, assemblies, curriculum visits, governance and fundraising.
The school supports the wider work of the church by promoting and contributing to events, and sharing training opportunities and resources.
The Life of Christ
We want to ensure that every child leaves St Mary's knowing about Jesus. This is something they learn about throughout their time here, but in the final term of Year 6 our pupils have a unique opportunity to see the whole story of Jesus' life played out in The Life of Christ, at Wintershall Estate near Guildford.
The trip is offered in partnership with St Mary's Church, who contribute to the experience both financially and by supporting follow-up learning and reflection in class.
This open-air reenactment of the gospels is played out over the pictureque Surrey Hills, and brings together all of the stories children have encountered throughout their primary education into one beautiful narrative.
Bibles for all
We want to encourage children to continue their faith journey after they leave St Mary's Primary School.
St Mary's Church generously gifts all school leavers with their own inscribed copy of the Bible, with the prayer that they will be inspired to read more of God's word, grow closer to Him, be curious learners and continue to grow in faith.
A special nativity
Children of all ages arrived at school to a very special Christmas treat, funded by a grant from St Mary's Church. A live action nativity, complete with sheep and a donkey, was taking place on the school playground!
Children moved around different stations, hearing the Christmas story told form the point of view of different characters, and collecting symbols to remind them of parts of the story.
